Still drawings computed from joint angles by the same locked engine as the approved 8, in the app's own colours. Tap Trace to play the path once, Mistake to see the common fault, and a label to highlight its cue.

App theme

Tier A: over the face, spinal load, overhead, explosive

How to do itBarbell Row

Keep the back flat, not rounded or arched, from start to finish.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Torso swings upThe torso swings up to heave the bar.
  2. Hips throwThe hips and lower back throw the weight up.
Pull1 s
Lower2 s

How to do itSingle-Leg Romanian Deadlift

Keep your head, back and free leg in one line, neck neutral.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Back roundsThe back and shoulders round as you reach down.
  2. Dumbbell too lowThe dumbbell is reached to the floor, well past mid-shin.
Lower2 s
Stand1 s
Balance1 s

How to do itBarbell Shrug

Keep your elbows straight and let your arms just hang.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Elbows bendThe elbows bend to pull the bar up.
  2. Arms pullThe arms lift the bar instead of the shoulders.
Lift1 s
Lower2 s

How to do itBox Jump

Bend the knees and hips while the arms swing back.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Knees straightThe knees stay straight as the feet land on the box.
  2. Stiff landingThe legs don't bend to absorb the landing.

How to do itDumbbell Bench Press

Keep your head, shoulders, hips and both feet down the whole set.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Hips lift offYour hips lift off the bench to push the weight up.
  2. Low back archesYour low back arches and the belly pushes up.
Lower2 s
Press1 s

How to do itIncline Dumbbell Press

Set the back pad to about 45 degrees, not steeper.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Forearm tiltedYour forearm leans instead of standing straight under the dumbbell.
  2. Weight driftsYour dumbbell drifts off the line of the elbow at the bottom.
Lower2 s
Press1 s

How to do itSeated Dumbbell Shoulder Press

Keep your head, shoulders and buttocks on the bench.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Back off padYour low back arches away from the pad as you press.
  2. Hips tip forwardYour hips tip forward and your belly pushes out.
Press1 s
Lower2 s

How to do itBarbell Overhead Press

Keep your elbows under the bar so your forearms point straight up.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Elbows backThe elbows sit behind the bar, so your forearms tilt.
  2. Bar drifts forwardThe bar curves forward, away from your face and mid-foot.
Press1 s
Lower2 s

How to do itRomanian Deadlift

Move your hips back to lower the bar and keep the slight knee bend fixed.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Lower back roundsThe lower back rounds at the bottom of the rep.
  2. Bar too lowThe bar is reached down to the floor by rounding the back.
Lower2 s
Stand1 s

Tier B

How to do itUpright Row

Lead with your elbows out to the sides, above your hands.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Bar under chinThe bar is pulled up under the chin.
  2. Elbows above shouldersThe elbows rise above the shoulders.
Pull1 s
Lower2 s

How to do itReverse Lunge

At the bottom, keep the front shin roughly vertical.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Trunk pitches forwardThe trunk pitches forward over the front thigh.
  2. Weight tips forwardThe weight tips onto the front foot instead of both.

How to do itPec Fly

Keep a slight, fixed bend in the elbows.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Stops shortThe arms stop partway instead of closing the full range.
  2. Handles apartThe handles finish well apart in front of the chest.
Close2 s
Hold2 s
Open2 s

Tier C

How to do itDumbbell Biceps Curl

Keep the upper arms by your sides, never back, at most slightly forward on top.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Leaning backThe torso leans back to throw the dumbbells up.
  2. Hips driveThe hips and knees push forward to heave the weight.
Curl1 s
Lower2 s

How to do itRope Triceps Pushdown

Keep the upper arms at the sides from top to bottom.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Elbows forwardThe elbows drift forward off the sides as the rope comes up.
  2. Leaning inThe torso tips forward over the rope to start the press.
Press1 s
Hold1 s
Return3 s

How to do itPlank

Stack the shoulders right over the elbows, and don't shrug.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Hips dropThe hips drop below the shoulder-to-heel line.
  2. Low back sagsThe low back sags toward the floor.
Hold10–60 s

How to do itMountain Climbers

Arms straight, hands right under the shoulders.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Hips hikeThe hips hike up as the knee drives forward.
  2. Line breaksHead to heels is no longer one straight line.
Work15 s
Rest15 s

How to do itTriceps Pushdown

Keep the upper arms against the sides so only the forearms move.

Saved offline
Tells
  1. Elbows forwardThe elbows drift forward off the sides as the bar comes up.
  2. Leaning inThe torso tips forward over the bar to start the press.
Press1 s
Hold1 s
Return2 s
